text:
Add GBrain memory to this existing agent. Read and follow:
https://raw.githubusercontent.com/garrytan/gbrain/master/INSTALL_FOR_AGENTS.md
Keep my current identity and instructions, start keyless, and show me the
search-mode choice. Verify a remember/recall round trip with real GBrain calls.

Install gbrain release v0.60.760.0 (`github:garrytan/gbrain#v0.60.760.0`) wherever the docs say #stable.
reply_text:
GBrain memory is installed on this agent with no API keys. Real GBrain calls saved and found a test note both from the command line and over MCP. Your identity and instructions are unchanged. One thing isn't proven yet: this conversation started before the setup, so the gbrain tools aren't loaded here. A gateway restart or a new session is needed to load them.

**What changed**
- **Install:** Bun 1.4.5, then `bun install -g github:garrytan/gbrain#v0.60.760.0` (version check prints `gbrain 0.60.760.0`). The brain is a local PGLite database at `~/.gbrain/brain.pglite` with embeddings off, so no text is sent to any embedding or AI provider.
- **OpenClaw config:** I registered gbrain as an MCP server (`openclaw mcp add …`), and `openclaw mcp doctor gbrain --probe` reports **ok**. `gbrain setup openclaw` added the `gbrain-turn-rule` plugin, which places a "check GBrain first" rule next to every turn.
  - Your existing model and agent settings are unchanged; only the `mcp` and `plugins` entries were added.
  - Saving the config removed the explanatory comments from `openclaw.json`. The original file, comments included, is at `openclaw.json.pre-gbrain.bak` in the same folder.
- **Identity:** `/workspace` had no `SOUL.md`, `IDENTITY.md` or `AGENTS.md`. Setup created `/workspace/AGENTS.md` containing only gbrain's marked block. I made no identity changes and skipped the optional identity and personal-agent bootstrap steps.
- **Setup warning:** `gbrain setup` first reported `turn_hook_not_loaded`. OpenClaw's own check shows the plugin loaded with `before_prompt_build`, and both a setup re-run and `gbrain doctor --only harness_wiring` now report the hook as wired. Separately, that doctor check also says "No agent harness was detected", even though `openclaw mcp doctor` passes.

**Remember/recall test**
- **Command line, separate processes:** `gbrain remember "…zephyr-orchid-7731…" --provenance install-check` saved fact #1. A new process found it with `gbrain recall` and with an exact-word `gbrain search`.
- **Over MCP:** I started the exact `gbrain serve` command OpenClaw runs and called it the way OpenClaw does (handshake, tool list, then tool calls). It listed `remember, recall, entity, forget, synthesize, context_pack, delta, request_tools`. `remember` saved fact #2 (`quartz-heron-4482`), and `recall` returned both markers.
- **After a restart:** a fresh server process recalled both markers again, so the notes are stored on disk.

**Search mode: conservative is in effect**
It was chosen automatically because there's no chat key and no reranker. You can change it any time:
```
Estimated downstream input cost of the retrieved payload @ 10K queries/mo:

                  Haiku 5.5     Sonnet 5.5    Opus 5.5
                  ($0.10/M in)  ($2/M in)     ($4/M in)
  conservative    $4/mo         $80/mo        $160/mo
  balanced        $10/mo        $200/mo       $400/mo
  tokenmax        $20/mo        $400/mo       $800/mo

  Assumed payload per query: conservative 4K, balanced 10K, tokenmax 20K tokens.
  Scales linearly: x10 for 100K queries/mo, /10 for 1K. 200x corner-to-corner spread.
  Embedding, reranking and query expansion are separate provider charges.
```
1. **conservative** (in effect): 4K budget, 10 chunks max, no reranker. Best for Haiku, cost-sensitive setups and high-volume loops.
2. **balanced**: 12K budget, 25 chunks, reranked.
3. **tokenmax**: no budget, 50 chunks, reranked; the widest retrieval, recommended once you add a chat key.

To switch, run `gbrain config set search.mode <mode>`, then `gbrain search modes` to confirm. Without keys, search matches exact words only.

**Other settings in effect**
- **Saving facts automatically:** off; agents save only what you ask. To turn it on, run `gbrain config set memory.auto_writeback salient` (recommended).
- **Free upkeep:** on while gbrain is running. To turn it off, run `gbrain config set maintenance.auto false`.
- **Conversation archive:** on; nothing leaves this machine without a key. To turn it off, run `gbrain transcripts archive off`.
- **Not set up:** API keys, background services, scheduled jobs and paid enrichment.

**Next steps**
1. Restart the OpenClaw gateway or open a new session so the gbrain tools and turn rule load. While it runs, use the MCP tools rather than the `gbrain` command: the local database allows one process at a time.
2. In that session, ask me to recall "quartz-heron-4482". If it comes back, I'll remove both test notes.

The install guide also suggests the hosted option at gbrain.io: one always-on brain shared by all your agents, nothing to keep running, and nothing is created until you choose a plan.
